source_title: ODNB Financial Corporation Reports Third Quarter 2026 Financial Results
source_excerpt:
ODNB delivers strong net interest income growth as an improved deposit mix and lower total cost of deposits drive further net interest margin expansion
TYSONS CORNER, Va. , Oct. 29, 2026 /PRNewswire/ -- ODNB Financial Corporation ("ODNB" or the "Company"), the holding company for Old Dominion National Bank (the "Bank") and its Centre 1 st Bank division ("Centre 1 st Bank"), reported financial results for the quarter ended September 30, 2026.
"ODNB delivered strong operating performance in the third quarter, highlighted by continued net interest margin expansion, double-digit growth in net interest income, improved operating efficiency, and continued growth in book value per share," said Chairman and Chief Executive Officer Mark Merrill. "Our relationship-based banking model continues to generate meaningful growth across loans, deposits and fee-based businesses while maintaining strong capital and liquidity. As we move through the fourth quarter, we remain focused on serving our clients, executing our organic growth strategy, and preparing for the successful completion of our strategic merger with National Capital Bancorp, Inc."
Strong Year-to-Date Earnings â Net income was $1.7 million for the third quarter of 2026 and $7.0 million for the nine months ended September 30, 2026, an increase of 18.3% from $5.9 million for the nine months ended September 30, 2025. Adjusted operating earnings (+) , excluding merger expenses, was $3.2 million for the third quarter of 2026 and $9.1 million for the nine months ended September 30, 2026.
Continued Margin Expansion â Net interest margin ("NIM") expanded to 3.10% in the third quarter of 2026, compared to 2.92% in the prior quarter and 2.84% in the third quarter of 2025. For the nine months ended September 30, 2026, NIM increased to 2.95%, compared to 2.75% for the prior-year period.
Strong Net Interest Income Growth â Net interest income increased to $13.0 million in the third quarter of 2026, up 10.5% from the prior quarter and 27.3% from the third quarter of 2025. For the nine months ended September 30, 2026, net interest income increased 23.8% to $35.6 million compared to $28.7 million for the prior-year period.
Valuable Core Deposit Franchise â Total deposits were $1.44 billion at September 30, 2026, increasing $196.3 million, or 15.8%, from September 30, 2025. Deposit mix continued to improve year-over-year as time deposits declined $117.9 million, or 30.6%, while non-interest bearing demand, NOW and interest-bearing demand, and money market and savings deposits increased $54.2 million, $122.8 million, and $137.2 million, respectively. Non-interest bearing demand deposits totaled $340.2 million and represented 23.7% of total deposits at September 30, 2026.
Disciplined Loan Growth â Gross loans totaled $1.40 billion at September 30, 2026, increasing $36.7 million, or 10.7% annualized, during the quarter and $134.5 million, or 10.6%, from September 30, 2025.
Improved Operating Efficiency â The efficiency ratio improved to 66.65% in the third quarter of 2026, compared to 68.48% in the prior quarter and 71.26% in the third quarter of 2025. The adjusted operating efficiency ratio (+) , excluding merger expenses, improved to 57.85% in the third quarter of 2026, compared to 63.46% in the prior quarter and 71.26% in the third quarter of 2025.
Stable Asset Quality â Nonaccrual loans totaled $12.3 million, or 0.88% of total gross loans, at September 30, 2026, compared to $11.6 million, or 0.85%, at June 30, 2026, and $13.8 million, or 1.09%, at September 30, 2025.
Book Value Growth â Book value per share increased to $13.20 at September 30, 2026, compared to $13.13 at June 30, 2026 and $12.36 at September 30, 2025. Tangible book value per share (+) increased to $13.20 at September 30, 2026, compared to $13.13 at June 30, 2026 and $12.36 at September 30, 2025. Tangible book value per share, excluding accumulated other comprehensive income ("AOCI") (+) , increased to $13.61 at September 30, 2026, compared to $13.44 at June 30, 2026 and $12.68 at September 30, 2025.
Well-Capitalized Balance Sheet â The Bank's regulatory capital ratios remained well above levels required to be considered "well capitalized," with a Tier 1 leverage ratio of 11.55%, Tier 1 risk-based capital ratio of 13.80%, and total risk-based capital ratio of 14.74% at September 30, 2026. The Company's equity to assets ratio was 8.68% at September 30, 2026.
Strategic Merger with National Capital Bancorp, Inc. â ODNB and National Capital Bancorp, Inc. ("NACB") announced a definitive merger agreement on June 15, 2026. The transaction is expected to create a larger community bank with approximately $2.6 billion in total assets. The Company continues to prepare for the transaction's anticipated completion in the fourth quarter of 2026, subject to the receipt of requisite shareholder approvals and other customary closing conditions. As previously announced, the transaction has received approval from the Office of the Comptroller of the Currency and non-objection to the request for a waiver of the approval requirements from the Federal Reserve Bank of Richmond. On October 28, 2026, the transaction received approval from the Bureau of Financial Institutions of the Virginia State Corporation Commission, and therefore, the parties have received all required regulatory approvals to complete the transaction.
Net income was $1.7 million for the third quarter of 2026, compared to $1.6 million in the prior quarter and $2.2 million in the third quarter of 2025. For the nine months ended September 30, 2026, net income was $7.0 million, increasing 18.3% from $5.9 million for the prior-year period. Adjusted operating earnings (+) , excluding $1.3 million and $1.9 million of merger expenses incurred during the third quarter and first nine months of 2026, respectively, was $3.2 million for the third quarter of 2026 and $9.1 million for the nine months ended September 30, 2026.
Net interest income totaled $13.0 million in the third quarter of 2026, increasing 10.5% from $11.7 million in the prior quarter and 27.3% from $10.2 million in the third quarter of 2025. For the nine months ended September 30, 2026, net interest income increased 23.8% to $35.6 million, compared to $28.7 million for the prior-year period. Growth in net interest income from the prior quarter reflected higher loan income and higher income from interest-bearing deposits and federal funds sold, while total interest expense was essentially flat from the prior quarter.
Net interest margin expanded to 3.10% in the third quarter of 2026, compared to 2.92% in the prior quarter and 2.84% in the third quarter of 2025. Deposit interest expense declined slightly from the prior quarter even as the Company maintained a strong deposit base during a period of rising market interest rates. For the nine months ended September 30, 2026, net interest margin increased to 2.95% from 2.75% for the prior-year period.
Provision expense was $2.0 million in the third quarter of 2026, compared to $2.0 million in the prior quarter and $375 thousand in the third quarter of 2025. For the nine months ended September 30, 2026, provision expense totaled $3.4 million, compared to $1.1 million for the prior-year period. During September 2026, the Company recorded a partial charge-off of approximately $1.4 million on a nonperforming loan and recognized a provision expense in the allowance for credit losses. The allowance for credit losses totaled $13.0 million, or 0.93% of total gross loans, at September 30, 2026, compared to $12.4 million, or 0.91%, at June 30, 2026, and $12.3 million, or 0.97%, at September 30, 2025.
Non-interest income totaled $1.2 million in the third quarter of 2026, relatively unchanged from the prior quarter and up 40.2% from $889 thousand in the third quarter of 2025. The year-over-year increase reflected higher service charges on deposit accounts and other service charges, gain on sale of loans, bank-owned life insurance income, wealth income, and other income. For the nine months ended September 30, 2026, non-interest income increased 52.4% to $3.5 million from $2.3 million in the prior-year period.
Non-interest expense totaled $9.5 million in the third quarter of 2026, compared to $8.9 million in the prior quarter and $7.9 million in the third quarter of 2025. The third quarter of 2026 included $1.3 million in merger expenses. Excluding these merger expenses, adjusted non-interest expense (+) was $8.2 million, essentially flat from the prior quarter. The year-over-year increase in reported non-interest expense primarily reflected merger expenses, higher salaries and employee benefits, occupancy and equipment expense, data processing expense, franchise taxes and other operating expense, partially offset by a reduction in FDIC assessment expense and professional services expense.
Improved operating leverage drove further efficiency gains, resulting in an efficiency ratio of 66.65%, compared to 68.48% in the prior quarter and 71.26% in the prior-year period and an adjusted efficiency ratio (+) of 57.85%, compared to 63.46% in the prior quarter and 71.26% in the prior-year period.
Total assets were $1.74 billion at September 30, 2026, compared to $1.80 billion at June 30, 2026 and $1.51 billion at September 30, 2025. The decrease from the prior quarter primarily reflected lower cash and cash equivalents, partially offset by continued loan growth and higher investment securities available for sale, while the year-over-year increase was primarily attributable to growth in loans and cash and cash equivalents.
Gross loans totaled $1.40 billion at September 30, 2026, increasing 2.7% from $1.37 billion at June 30, 2026 and 10.6% from $1.27 billion at September 30, 2025. Loan growth during the quarter was diversified across the portfolio, with increases in all major loan categories. The Company continues to emphasize high-quality, relationship-based loan growth across its markets while maintaining disciplined underwriting standards.
Total deposits were $1.44 billion at September 30, 2026, compared to $1.49 billion at June 30, 2026 and $1.24 billion at September 30, 2025. Compared to the prior quarter, money market and savings deposits increased $71.7 million while time deposits declined $46.9 million, non-interest bearing demand deposits declined $20.0 million and NOW and interest-bearing demand deposits declined $59.2 million. Compared with the prior-year period, total deposits increased $196.3 million, or 15.8%, while time deposits declined 30.6%. Non-interest bearing demand deposits totaled $340.2 million and represented 23.7% of total deposits at September 30, 2026. The Company reduced its total cost of deposits 46 basis points from 2.93% in the third quarter of 2025 to 2.47% in the current quarter.
The Company maintained substantial on-balance-sheet liquidity at September 30, 2026. Cash and cash equivalents totaled $208.2 million, compared to $302.3 million at June 30, 2026 and $131.3 million at September 30, 2025. Available-for-sale investment securities totaled $62.2 million at September 30, 2026 and were fully unpledged.
Asset quality remained stable during the third quarter of 2026. Nonaccrual loans totaled $12.3 million, or 0.88% of total gross loans, at September 30, 2026, compared to $11.6 million, or 0.85%, at June 30, 2026 and $13.8 million, or 1.09%, at September 30, 2025.
The allowance for credit losses totaled $13.0 million, or 0.93% of total gross loans, at September 30, 2026, compared to $12.4 million, or 0.91%, at June 30, 2026 and $12.3 million, or 0.97%, at September 30, 2025. Net charge-offs to average loans were 0.33% on an annualized basis for the third quarter of 2026, compared to 0.43% for the second quarter of 2026 and 0.10% for the third quarter of 2025.
The Bank's regulatory capital ratios remained well above levels required to be considered "well capitalized," with a Tier 1 leverage ratio of 11.55%, a Tier 1 risk-based capital ratio of 13.80%, and a total risk-based capital ratio of 14.74% at September 30, 2026. The Company's equity-to-assets ratio was 8.68% at September 30, 2026.
Book value per share increased to $13.20 at September 30, 2026, compared to $13.13 at June 30, 2026 and $12.36 at September 30, 2025. Tangible book value per share (+) increased to $13.20 at September 30, 2026, compared to $13.13 at June 30, 2026 and $12.36 at September 30, 2025. Tangible book value per share, excluding AOCI (+) , increased to $13.61 at September 30, 2026, compared to $13.44 at June 30, 2026 and $12.68 at September 30, 2025.
(+) These are financial measures not calculated in accordance with generally accepted accounting principles ("GAAP"). For a reconciliation of these non-GAAP financial measures, see the reconciliations provided on page 10.
ODNB Financial Corporation is the holding company for Old Dominion National Bank, a locally owned community bank serving markets including the Washington, D.C. metropolitan area. The Bank's executive headquarters is located in the heart of Northern Virginia in Tysons Corner, with full-service branches in Tysons Corner and Leesburg, Virginia, two Albemarle County branches serving communities in Central Virginia and an office in Boca Raton serving customers in South Florida.
Centre 1st Bank, a wholly owned division of Old Dominion National Bank, serves customers in Pennsylvania and New Jersey from offices in State College, Pennsylvania.
ODNB Wealth Management, a wholly owned division of the Bank, serves clients from its office in Haverford, Pennsylvania.
ODNB offers a full range of commercial and consumer financial services, including commercial and industrial lending, commercial real estate financing, residential mortgage lending, deposit services, and wealth management solutions, in the communities it serves. The Company had $1.74 billion in total assets at September 30, 2026.

Certain information set forth in this press release refers to financial measures that are determined by methods other than in accordance with GAAP. These non-GAAP financial measures are a supplement to GAAP, which ODNB uses to prepare its financial statements, and should not be considered in isolation or as a substitute for comparable measures calculated in accordance with GAAP. In addition, ODNB's non-GAAP financial measures may not be comparable to non-GAAP financial measures of other companies.
The Company uses the non-GAAP financial measures discussed herein in its analysis of its performance. These include adjusted non-interest expense, adjusted operating earnings, adjusted efficiency ratio, tangible book value per share and tangible book value per share excluding accumulated other comprehensive income. Management believes that these non-GAAP financial measures provide additional understanding of ODNB's ongoing operations, enhance the comparability of ODNB's results of operations with prior periods and show the effects of significant gains and charges in the periods presented without the impact of items or events that may obscure trends in ODNB's underlying performance. Specifically, ODNB believes that adjusted non-interest expense, adjusted operating earnings and adjusted efficiency ratio provide important information about the continuing economic results of ODNB's operations. ODNB believes that tangible book value per share and tangible book value per share excluding accumulated other comprehensive income provides an important metric with which to analyze and evaluate the financial condition and capital strength of ODNB.
Non-GAAP financial measures may be identified with the symbol (+) and may be labeled as adjusted. For a reconciliation of these measures to their most directly comparable GAAP measures, see page 10.
